name: stubborn_explorer_20ng
description: Long-session explorer on 20 Newsgroups. Alternates re-embeddings and structural edits. Stress-tests state coherence across many turns.
goal: Run a long, varied session: (1) re-embed by 'subject domain', (2) split the largest resulting cluster, (3) re-embed by 'writing tone', (4) merge two redundant clusters, (5) rename one cluster with a precise label, (6) re-embed once more by an axis you haven't used. Declare satisfied only after all six steps completed.

notes.tone: patient, exploratory, willing to wait through long sequences
notes.extra: Use explicit re-embed verbs ('cluster by X'). Never repeat an axis. Between re-embeds, the previous cluster UUIDs are gone — always work off the NEW cluster list shown in the panel.
